recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Any future change to artifact-citeAs contexts, datatype choices, or naming should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack; core follow-up is only needed if the Clinical Reasoning page's extension-pack link or description becomes stale.
issue_request: FHIR-30256 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to add a citeAs extension, renamed from cqf-citeAs to citeAs, with 0..1 value[x] supporting Reference(Citation) or markdown so resources/artifacts could state how they should be cited.
initial_application: No current core StructureDefinition and no core git commit tagged FHIR-30256 were found for a citeAs extension. The apparent implementation history is in the FHIR Extension Pack: commit f34e5e1 added StructureDefinition-artifact-citeAs from the CRMI IG with context Resource and value[x] Reference or markdown. Core later gained only an OID entry and a Clinical Reasoning module link to the extension-pack artifact-citeAs page.
additional_context: Later extension-pack decisions narrowed and maintained the extension outside core. FHIR-41650 updated artifact extension contexts from Resource to explicit artifact-like resources, and FHIR-55470 added further approved contexts for artifact-citeAs. FHIR-53078 updated the current core Clinical Reasoning module to list artifact-citeAs while stating that the Extension Pack is the source of truth if local descriptions diverge. Later R6 RelatedArtifact work added direct citeAs elements to selected resources where core elements were approved, so it does not require reintroducing a core extension definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source was changed because the authoritative citeAs extension definition is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack, and current core source correctly links to that external extension-pack definition rather than defining it locally.
